verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's own pages confirm it offers automations: the homepage advertises "automations," the pricing page lists "Enhanced automations," and Analytics AI reports on which automations drive revenue. A community post also mentions building "a Mailchimp automation." None of the evidence shows multi-step journeys, welcome/onboarding/winback templates, branching logic, delays, or exit rules. Missing for 10: documented multi-step workflow builder, conditional branches, time delays, exit/goal rules, lifecycle templates (welcome, onboarding, winback), and hands-on corroboration.
